copy.systems.pencil.footnote: The famous version of the pen story, where one side spends millions on a space pen while the other simply uses a pencil, is a myth. Pencil tips snap and graphite dust conducts, a hazard in orbit; the pressurised pen was developed privately, and both programmes ended up buying it.
